models.title: Crack500 U-Net (ResNet34) - crack segmentation
models.status: FROZEN v1.0 (model of record for segmentation)
models.evidence: VERIFIED_FROM_FILES (metrics.json, test_metrics.json, config.json, checkpoint SHA256; test Dice re-derived independently by the hybrid evaluation)
models.dataset: Crack500 (official split: train 1,896 / val 348 / test 1,124 image-mask pairs)
models.architecture: segmentation_models_pytorch Unet, ResNet34 encoder (ImageNet-initialised), 1 output channel
limitations: Test Dice is about 7 points below validation Dice; report both.
Architecture differences (<=0.8 pt) are within seed noise (SD 0.48 pt); U-Net was chosen for simplicity, not demonstrated superiority.
Seed 42 was the best of 3 seeds, so its validation score is slightly optimistic; the test score is unaffected.
Crack500 is pavement imagery; behaviour on concrete decks/walls is untested.
Annotations are thick and coarse: boundary F1 is 39% at 2 px tolerance, 79% at 8 px.
Official split has 80 images in source photos shared across splits (37 in test); sensitivity analysis shows no material effect on mean image Dice.
Measurements derived from masks are in pixels only (no calibration).
not_for: Physical (mm) measurements without a calibrated scale
pending: Confirm best.pt hash on the deployment copy

models.title: Crack500 YOLO11n-Seg - crack localisation (experiment)
models.status: EXPERIMENTAL v0.1 (not the segmentation model of record)
models.evidence: PARTLY VERIFIED: label conversion report and validation/test metrics from files; weights hash, training args and detection mAP not provided
models.task: Crack localisation (boxes, confidence) and coarse instance masks
models.dataset: Crack500, labels converted from masks to YOLO polygons; official split preserved

training.defaults: 100 epochs, imgsz 640, batch 16, patience 20, seed 42, cosine LR (check args.yaml: NEEDS VERIFICATION)

results.detection_map: NOT YET MEASURED on Crack500 (run Ultralytics val once on the frozen best.pt and record box/mask mAP50, mAP50-95)

limitations: Masks are coarse (prototype masks at 1/4 input resolution); thin cracks lose detail.
Mask-to-polygon conversion fills holes and drops components under 6 px.
Do not compare with the Crack-seg demo model: different dataset.
pending: Box/mask mAP on the test split (one run, frozen weights)

models.title: Hybrid pipeline: YOLO11n-Seg gating + U-Net masks
models.evidence: VERIFIED_FROM_FILES (hybrid_config.json, val_grid.csv, test_results.json); one-shot test evaluation
models.task: Boxes + confidence from YOLO, pixel masks from U-Net, fused by a gating rule (not a plain OR)
models.architecture: HybridCrackPipeline (ml/hybrid/hybrid_pipeline.py); fusion: U-Net prob >= t_in inside YOLO region, >= t_out outside (None = nothing outside)

training.selection: 144-config grid on validation only; two variants declared before the test run

limitations: No segmentation accuracy gain over the U-Net alone; the value is boxes + detection confidence.
ROI-crop mode gave no speed gain on 640x360 images (ROIs cover most of the image); gains on large images are untested.
Pooled metrics excluding leak-flagged images were reported incorrectly by the first evaluator version (bug fixed; only the mean-image-Dice sensitivity is valid: U-Net 0.7021 vs dual 0.7025).

models.title: SDNET2018 ConvNeXt-Tiny - crack / no-crack patch classification
models.evidence: Fold-0 comparison VERIFIED_FROM_FILES (sdnet_report.md, inventory.csv); thresholds and fold-0 test counts from a pasted metrics.json; five-fold summary REPORTED_NOT_VERIFIED
models.task: Binary classification of 256x256 concrete patches (decks, pavements, walls)
models.dataset: SDNET2018, 56,092 images; photo-grouped 5-fold splits (group = surface + filename prefix); fold 0 used for model comparison
models.architecture: torchvision ConvNeXt-Tiny, ImageNet-initialised, single logit, two-phase fine-tuning, weighted BCE

fold0_model_comparison_pr_auc.note: ConvNeXt vs DenseNet diff -0.001 [-0.015,+0.010]: tie; MobileNetV3 lower by 0.018 [-0.030,-0.009]

five_fold_reported.caveat: fold configurations were not controlled; files not re-verified

limitations: Fold 0 scores higher than the reported five-fold mean (PR-AUC 88.6 vs 85.0); quote both.
At 90% recall, about 42% of alerts are false (precision 57.6% on fold 0, ~46% reported across folds).

Blind audit (one fold, one non-expert reviewer): of 60 most-confident false positives, 28 looked like real cracks and 22 ambiguous; of 40 lowest-scoring 'cracked' images, 30 showed no crack. Tail samples only, not a dataset noise rate.
Does not transfer from the Concrete Crack dataset; trained on SDNET2018 only.
ResNet50 was excluded from the consolidated comparison: no verifiable output on the same test set (an earlier run used a different split, PR-AUC 0.805 not comparable).
pending: Fold 1-4 outputs if the five-fold table is to be re-verified

models.title: Concrete Crack Images ResNet50 - binary baseline
models.dataset: Concrete Crack Images for Classification: 40,000 -> 38,402 after exact-duplicate removal; grouped split train 26,892 / val 5,773 / test 5,737
limitations: In-domain score is saturated (a 3-feature logistic regression reaches 96.7%); it says little about real performance.
Fails on SDNET2018 (ROC-AUC 0.71): learned texture/contrast shortcuts.

models.title: Crack-seg YOLO11n-Seg - existing FastAPI demo model
models.evidence: App code VERIFIED_FROM_FILES (app.py, scripts, README); training metrics REPORTED_NOT_VERIFIED (no results.csv provided)
models.task: Demo crack detection + masks inside the FastAPI intake app
models.dataset: Crack-seg dataset (train 3,717 / val 112 / test 200); NOT Crack500
limitations: 3 epochs on CPU at 320 px: a pipeline demonstration, not a quality benchmark.
Not comparable with Crack500 models (different data).
Demo quality checks: brightness<45, Laplacian variance<60; the blur rule mislabels smooth concrete (uncracked concrete patches average ~32) and depends on resolution.
Stored 'original' is re-encoded to JPEG; README text still says ai_prediction 'not_run'; page text mentions normalisation that the code does not perform.

models.title: RDD2022_India YOLO11s - road damage detection
models.status: FROZEN v1.0 (model of record for dashcam road damage detection)
models.task: Multi-class bounding-box detection of road damage in street-view / dashcam imagery (D00 longitudinal crack, D10 transverse crack, D20 alligator crack, D40 pothole)
models.dataset: RDD2022_India converted to YOLO format (val 1,150 images / 1,068 boxes; test 1,200 images / 1,058 boxes)
models.architecture: Ultralytics YOLO11s (100 layers fused, 9,414,348 parameters, 21.4 GFLOPs), 4 classes (D00, D10, D20, D40)
limitations: Severe class imbalance on D10 (transverse cracks): only 17 boxes in val and 17 in test (flagged reliable=False); unweighted macro mAP50 is pulled down by ~9-10 points.
Trained exclusively on Indian dashcam road imagery (RDD2022_India); performance on other regions, lighting conditions, or close-up structural concrete is untested.
Bounding boxes only (no pixel-level segmentation masks or physical mm measurements).
not_for: Close-up concrete crack width/length measurement (use Crack500 U-Net)
